description: Маршрути громадського транспорту міста Знам’янка is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Знам'янська міська рада. Інформація про рух громадського руху Знам’янської громади Кропивницького району Кіровоградської області. Coverage: Знам'янська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Знам'янська міська рада. Its keywords include маршрути, транспорт. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLS, XLSX. The listing shows 2025-05-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
